scope: Root-cause investigation of intermittent Cloudflare-to-origin failures for vagaaqui.com
confirmed: Cloudflare failures continued through 2026-11-03T04:35:25Z in the last queried window, including normal CSS asset requests, not only monitor traffic
Passive external-NIC capture identified five new TLS flows by SNI vagaaqui.com; some were healthy and others exhibited repeated handshake packets and outbound data retransmissions
Affected host answered initial SYNs within approximately 0.033 to 0.044 milliseconds for cited target flows, yet peers repeated SYNs
Independent ss TCP state showed substantial retransmissions, backoff, slow delivery and MSS reduced to 48 bytes on affected Cloudflare-facing sockets
Current resources, conntrack occupancy and NIC hardware error counters did not show saturation or physical-interface errors during continuing failures
Official Cloudflare IPv4 ranges were fully covered by the live BitNinja whitelist and proxy-list sets; inspected blacklist sets did not overlap these ranges
The cited UptimeRobot IP was absent from inspected greylist and blacklist sets

interpretation.confirmed_fault_layer: Intermittent TCP/TLS transport degradation between this origin and specific Cloudflare peers, before WordPress for the connection/handshake failures
not_proven: PHP worker shortage as the cause of 522/525
Provider core-router maintenance as the cause
End-to-end packet-loss percentage from incomplete MTR hops
interpretation.historical_resources_limitation: No sar/atop/netdata historical collector was found. Current resource checks apply only to contemporaneous continued failures.
interpretation.mtr_limitation: Destination not reached in TCP traces; intermediate missing replies cannot localize a loss-causing hop. No intermediate loss percentage is promoted to root cause.

earlier_collector_limitations: First text tcpdump collector could omit truncated packet summaries; handshake attribution uses the later structured pcap parser instead
Initial MTR JSON calls exited without a usable report; text-mode traces with detached stdin returned usable but incomplete route evidence
sar is not installed; /proc and live vmstat were used, without installing software
blocker: No validated provider-control-plane credential for MatteiInc01 was found among scoped existing references. The available Hetzner server reference is a guest console for a different host, not this provider account. Provider-side routing/peering investigation and possible Cloudflare coordination are required for attribution/remediation.
recommendation: Ask the responsible Hetzner account owner to submit the prepared network support draft and correlate UTC timestamps and peers. Do not restart PHP/server, disable BitNinja or change MTU/firewall speculatively.
next_action: Obtain the existing provider support route or have the account owner submit the evidence; reconcile provider findings before proposing an exact production change.
